faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Executive post at IIT Madras is 23rd September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Executive role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com with at least 75% marks, or an M.Com with a minimum of 60% marks, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering in Supply Chain Management, Logistics Management, or Materials Management with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in Purchase, Logistics, or Supply Chain is required for the Junior Executive position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Executive post is 28 years. However, age relaxation is provided for SC & ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC and ST candidates are eligible for an age relaxation, with the maximum age limit extended to 30 years for them.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Executive post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for IIT Madras Junior Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Executive role?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a Written/Skill Test, an Interview, and finally, Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Executive position at IIT Madras is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website of IIT Madras is also provided for further reference.
